summary: Recommendation-first plan completed and made internally consistent: legacy PDF app deleted, reuse survey widened (ASReview as the clean profile engine), S0-S6 stage plan and 20 traceability gates registered, and an explicit pre-build token budget proposal added (zero-token core; bounded AI layer) with prompt contracts and daily/monthly arithmetic. No runtime, model call or quality measurement is claimed.
scope_note: files covers the entire current worktree: the owner-directed legacy deletion plus this unit's research/plan/budget/harness edits. Historical replan records and archived docs are retained as history. Agent self-review only; independent review and owner approval are still outstanding.

budget_impact.rationale: No application runtime exists and no provider request was made. The unit registers an UNAPPROVED DeepSeek operation/scenario proposal so the daily minimum is computable; approved_by_owner, runtime_enforcement_implemented and tokenizer_parity_verified all remain false and release stays blocked. Core search/ranking/profile/archive/DB maintenance stay zero model token; ordinary metadata-API cost and private-data egress are not measured here.
budget_impact.before: budget.json had no provider/operations (post-reset zero-model placeholder) and docs/BUDGET.generated.md was stale/pending; no pre-build daily token figure existed.
budget_impact.after: budget.json registers an unapproved DeepSeek (deepseek-flash) proposal: 5 prompt-backed operations, 4 scenarios; core no-AI = 0 token; daily triage+weekly digest = ~4,500 token/day reference, ~10,800/day cap; monthly cap demand ~192k. Not measured, not authorized.
